initial.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime][bug] Make installed Runtime generations coherent and deploy merged A2A
initial.goal: Make CSM, Guardian, and Kernel agree on Runtime configuration identity and deploy the merged A2A path on Wuji.
initial.required_outcome: One current-source generation starts under launchd with owned readiness and Beacon delivers a distinct agent-addressed turn to Ember.
authority_boundary: Issue #707 owns cross-binary configuration identity and live deployment proof
Merged #693 remains authority for A2A action-selection behavior
The live init content, agent roster, and provider assignments are not changed
The known-good installed generation remains rollback authority until acceptance passes
operator_constraints: Do not write tracked changes on main
Keep Wuji on a healthy generation while source repair proceeds
Do not weaken fail-closed generation validation
Use canonical CSM and launchd only
initial.task_boundary: Repair deterministic cross-binary generation identity, prove it with focused tests, install a coherent generation, and demonstrate live Beacon-to-Ember delivery.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: CSM, Guardian, and Kernel derive identical configuration generation and receipt identity for the same init and binary generation
AC-2: Generation validation remains fail closed for content, compatibility, receipt, and executable mismatch
AC-3: One release generation containing all three current-source binaries verifies and starts under launchd without restart exhaustion
AC-4: Wuji readiness, ownership identities, observability, roster eligibility, and model residency remain healthy
AC-5: Beacon emits a distinct agent-to-agent work item addressed to Ember and Ember receives it; operator reply alone is not accepted as proof
AC-6: Focused validation, diff hygiene, bounded subagent review, and typed publication pass
non_goals: No init or agent configuration changes
initial.plan_summary: Canonicalize receipt identity, add a cross-manifest regression, build and install one coherent generation, restart through CSM, and prove real Beacon-to-Ember delivery.

steps.action: Reproduce and isolate the cross-binary receipt mismatch.
Implement canonical identity and focused cross-manifest regression proof.
Build, verify, and install one coherent release generation with rollback retained.
Run live Beacon-to-Ember A2A acceptance and inspect distinct delivery evidence.
Complete bounded review and typed publication.

invariants: All binaries agree on identity without sharing mutable state
Only one launchd-managed Runtime owns the ports
Operator reply is not evidence of agent-to-agent delivery
risks: Changing canonical encoding could invalidate retained receipts
Independent Cargo graphs may conceal further behavioral drift
Live A2A model selection may decline an action even when transport works
stop_conditions: The live init must change to pass
A competing Runtime owns the listener
Focused tests expose broader incompatible persisted-state migration
Subagent review finds unresolved P1 or P2 defects

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove deterministic identity and fail-closed mismatch handling across production binary manifests.
Prove touched Runtime packages compile and focused tests pass.
Prove owned readiness and a distinct Beacon-to-Ember delivery after generation install.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Created during implementation and run only after local proof and review.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Reject formatting and range-diff hygiene defects.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on any identity disagreement, receipt or executable mismatch, competing listener, unhealthy rollout, ambiguous A2A recipient, or unresolved review finding; roll back to the retained known-good generation on live failure.
review_prompts: Is receipt identity byte-stable across independently resolved package graphs?
Can any mismatched init, generation, executable, or receipt pass?
Does live proof distinguish operator reply from a separately addressed and received Ember work item?
initial.review_scope: Cross-binary configuration-generation identity, install/start behavior, rollback safety, and live Beacon-to-Ember A2A proof only.
